pr_title: Fix install windows features when install state is removed
pr_body:
Signed-off-by: dheerajd-msys <dheeraj.dubey@msystechnologies.com>

<!--- Provide a short summary of your changes in the Title above -->
windows features were not getting installed when it's InstallState was `Removed`
## Description
<!--- Describe your changes in detail, what problems does it solve? -->
- This change handles installing features when state is removed or disabled(available)
- Works for single as well as multi-feature installation
- Earlier intersection of the features returned nil when state was `Removed` so feature was not getting installed.
- Ensured `Idempotent`  for the `windows_feature_powershell`
- Redundant test removed
## Related Issue
<!--- If you are suggesting a new feature or change, please create an issue first -->
<!--- Please link to the issue, discourse, or stackoverflow here: -->
Fixes https://github.com/chef/chef/issues/9536

Recipe: (chef-apply cookbook)::(chef-apply recipe)
  * windows_feature[NET-Framework-Core] action install
    * windows_feature_powershell[NET-Framework-Core] action install
      - install Windows feature net-framework-core

PS C:\Users\Administrator\chef> Get-WindowsFeature -Name NET-Framework-Core

Display Name                                            Name                       Install State
------------                                            ----                       -------------
    [X] .NET Framework 3.5 (includes .NET 2.0 and 3.0)  NET-Framework-Core             Installed


PS C:\Users\Administrator\chef>
PS C:\Users\Administrator\chef> Get-WindowsFeature -Name Web-Net-Ext45

Display Name                                            Name                       Install State
------------                                            ----                       -------------
            [ ] .NET Extensibility 4.6                  Web-Net-Ext45                  Available

Display Name                                            Name                       Install State
------------                                            ----                       -------------
            [ ] .NET Extensibility 4.6                  Web-Net-Ext45                  Available

      - install Windows features web-asp-net45,web-net-ext45

issue_context.title: windows_feature_powershell does not install feature with "-Source" when it has install state "Removed"
issue_context.body:
## Description
When installing a feature using the resource `windows_feature_powershell` it should try to install when a source is provided. It does not when the install state is `Removed`

The install will not be triggered when `features_to_install.empty?` is true.
See: 
https://github.com/chef/chef/blob/v15.8.23/lib/chef/resource/windows_feature_powershell.rb#L72

## Chef Version
v15.8.23

## Platform Version
Windows 2016

## Replication Case
Install a feature that has install state `Removed` and provide the `source` property.


Recipe:
```
windows_feature 'Net-Framework-Core' do
  source '\\\\<share>\\sxs\\'
  install_method :windows_feature_powershell
end
```

Powershell:
```> get-windowsfeature Net-Framework-Core

Display Name                                            Name                       Install State
------------                                            ----                       -------------
    [ ] .NET Framework 3.5 (includes .NET 2.0 and 3.0)  NET-Framework-Core               Removed
```

Running the command `Install-WindowsFeature Net-Framework-Core -Source \\<share>\sxs` will install the featured as expected.

## Client Output
```
    * windows_feature_powershell[Net-Framework-Core] action install[2020-03-25T13:26:12+01:00] INFO: Processing windows_feature_powershell[Net-Framework-Core] action install (C:/opscode/chef/embedded/lib/ruby/gems/2.6.0/gems/chef-15.8.23-universal-mingw32/lib/chef/resource/windows_feature.rb line 78)
[2020-03-25T13:26:12+01:00] DEBUG: Caching Windows features available via Get-WindowsFeature.
(...cut cached ouptut...)
[2020-03-25T13:26:14+01:00] DEBUG: Windows features needing installation: none
 (up to date)
     (up to date)
```
comments:
FYI this seems fine as a work-around:
```
powershell_script 'Install NET-Framework-Core' do
  code <<-EOH
  Install-WindowsFeature -Name NET-Framework-Core -Source \\\\<share>\\sxs
  EOH
  not_if "(Get-WindowsFeature -Name NET-Framework-Core).Installed"
end
```

review_comments: @lamont This test was redundant so removed one of them https://github.com/chef/chef/blob/master/spec/unit/resource/windows_feature_powershell_spec.rb#L30:L38

These tests don't test the behavior that was added in this PR.

What do you think about some tests like:

```
it "does not attempt to install features that have been removed" do
  node["powershell_features_cache"]["disabled"] = ["dhcp"]
  node["powershell_features_cache"]["removed"] = ["snmp"]
  resource.feature_name "dhcp, "snmp"

  expect(resource.features_to_install).to eq(["dhcp"])
end

it "attempts to install features that have been removed when source is set" do
  node["powershell_features_cache"]["disabled"] = ["dhcp"]
  node["powershell_features_cache"]["removed"] = ["snmp"]
  resource.feature_name "dhcp, "snmp"
  resource.source "some appropriate value"

  expect(resource.features_to_install).to eq(["dhcp", "snmp"])
end
```
In process to add these tests, Was getting `undefined method []= for nil:NilClass` while implementing these.
Depending on what the error was, you might need to add something like `node["powershell_features_cache"] ||= {}`.
Resolved now and updated, Thank you @phiggins !!
